topics.title: Mathematical Foundations: Semilattices, Commutativity & Idempotence
topics.objective: Understand partial orderings, joins, and monotonic state merge requirements for distributed consensus.
topics.example: merge(A, B) == merge(B, A) && merge(A, merge(B, C)) == merge(merge(A, B), C)
topics.exercise: Prove and implement a state-based Grow-Only Counter (G-Counter) satisfying semilattice axioms.

topics.title: PN-Counters & Last-Write-Wins (LWW) Element Sets
topics.objective: Support additions, subtractions, and updates using vector clocks and Lamport timestamps.
topics.exercise: Implement an LWW-Register with logical timestamps resolving concurrent property writes deterministically.

topics.title: Sequence CRDTs (RGA, Logoot & Yjs Model)
topics.objective: Represent real-time collaborative text character insertions and deletions without position shifting anomalies.
topics.exercise: Build a basic Replicated Growable Array (RGA) managing peer character insertions.

topics.title: Garbage Collection & Tombstone Compaction
topics.objective: Compact deleted element records (tombstones) safely once all active replicas have synchronized.
topics.exercise: Write a compaction routine purging deleted text nodes confirmed by all cluster vector clocks.

topics.title: Peer-to-Peer State Synchronization via WebRTC & WebSockets
topics.objective: Transmit delta state updates and binary encoded diffs across collaborative peers.
topics.exercise: Implement a real-time collaborative notepad syncing character changes across two browser windows.
